report: Since last night I have felt a tightness in my chest that spreads to my left arm, I am in a cold sweat and could not go to work today.
identified_symptoms: chest tightness; cold sweat; pain radiating to the arm

report: For about three weeks I have noticed constant tiredness and my legs are swollen at the end of the day, so I stopped taking my walks.
For the past fifteen days I have had palpitations and my heart feels racing even at rest, which has been ruining my sleep.
Last week I felt dizzy when getting out of bed and I even fainted once in the bathroom, so now I am afraid of being home alone.
identified_symptoms: dizziness; dizziness when standing up; fainting

report: For two months I have had shortness of breath when climbing stairs and I need to sleep on several pillows because lying flat leaves me breathless.
identified_symptoms: shortness of breath; shortness of breath on exertion; shortness of breath when lying down

report: Yesterday, during my run, I felt chest pain that went away after a few minutes of rest, and since then I avoid any kind of exertion.
identified_symptoms: chest pain; pain on exertion; relief with rest

report: For four days I have had a fever and chest pain that gets worse when I breathe deeply and improves when I lean forward, so I missed my classes.
identified_symptoms: chest pain; fever; pain that worsens when breathing; relief when leaning forward

report: Over the last few weeks my blood pressure has been running high, I have a headache at the back of my neck and my vision gets blurry, which keeps me from driving.
identified_symptoms: blurred vision; headache; high blood pressure

report: Since last week I have had irregular heartbeats, a feeling that my heart is skipping beats and fatigue, and I cannot finish my workday.
This morning I woke up with calf pain, my right leg is swollen and suddenly I started to feel short of breath, so I canceled all my appointments.
identified_symptoms: calf pain; shortness of breath; sudden shortness of breath; swollen legs
